name: UAE fintech onsite role
notes: Onsite in Dubai, fintech, includes visa sponsorship. Tests location + benefits parsing.

inputs.text:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Careem Pay (Dubai, UAE, on-site)

Careem Pay is the fintech arm of Careem, MENA's leading super-app. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer for the wallet and P2P transfers squad. This role is on-site at our Dubai Internet City office.

The role:
- Own end-to-end features across our Node.js + TypeScript backend and our Next.js merchant dashboard.
- Partner with our regulatory team on Central Bank of the UAE compliance for new payment products.
- Ship to millions of users across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, and Jordan.

Must-have:
- 5+ years of production TypeScript.
- Experience with regulated financial services (PSP, e-money, or banking).
- Comfortable with Postgres, Redis, and event-driven architectures (Kafka).

What we offer:
- Competitive AED-denominated compensation.
- Full UAE work visa + medical insurance for employee and dependents.
- Relocation package for hires from outside UAE.
- Annual home-country flights.
- 30 days annual leave.
- Restricted stock units in Careem's parent (Uber).

Dress code business casual. Standard working week Monday–Friday.
